column1: # Feature lanes for the broken intra-doc link gate (scripts/check_rustdoc_links.sh,
# WHY THIS FILE EXISTS. `cargo doc` resolves DEFAULT features only, so a module
# behind a non-default feature is never documented and its links are never
# checked. The gate reported `0 broken link(s)` across every crate while
# `cargo doc -p trusty-mcp --features config` exited 101 on an ambiguous link
# inside the default-off `config` feature. `#![deny(rustdoc::broken_intra_doc_links)]`
# then turns a link this gate missed into a RELEASE-TIME failure at
# preflight-publish.sh Gate 1 — trusty-mcp 0.1.1 burned a version number that way.
# `--all-features` is not available here: trusty-common's `embedder-*` ORT
# variants are mutually exclusive at the `ort-sys` level. So the coverage is
# DECLARED, one row at a time, and the gate refuses to run until every declared
# feature of every documented crate appears below. Adding a feature to a crate
# fails this gate (FEATURE-UNCOVERED) until it is placed — which is the point:
# the alternative is a feature lane nobody notices is missing.
# ROW KINDS (tab-separated, first field is the kind):
#   LANE    <lane-id>  <crate>/<feature>[,<crate>/<feature>...]
#       One extra `cargo doc --workspace` pass per lane id, with `--features`
#       set to the union of every LANE row carrying that id. Rows merge, so a
#       lane is written one crate per row. Every crate a lane names must come
#       back FRESHLY documented in that lane's own stream or the gate fails
#       (LANE-NOT-EXAMINED) — an unbuildable feature set is a failure, never a
#       silent skip.
#   NO-CFG  <crate>    <feature>
#       Exempt because the feature gates no `cfg` site anywhere in that crate's
#       `src/**`, so enabling it documents no additional item. THE GATE VERIFIES
#       THIS: if the feature ever gains a `feature = "<name>"` site in that
#       crate's source, the row becomes invalid and the gate fails
#       (NO-CFG-STALE). A rotted exemption cannot sit here unnoticed.
#   SKIP    <crate>    <feature>   <reason>
#       Exempt because the feature cannot be BUILT on a stock runner. The reason
#       is mandatory and is not machine-checkable, so each row is a real
#       coverage hole that has to earn its place. "It is slow" is not a reason.
#       Same bar as scripts/semver-checks-feature-exclusions.tsv, which carries
#       the matching rows for the same features.
# The four Tauri GUI crates the gate excludes outright (trusty-mpm-gui,
# trusty-code-gui, trusty-agents-ui, trusty-audit-ui) need no rows: they are
# never documented. trusty-audit-ui joined that list in #7466 — it needs
# WebKit2GTK exactly as its three siblings do, and carrying a row for a crate
# the run excludes is a claim about documentation that never happens.
# Regenerate the inventory this file must cover:
#   cargo metadata --no-deps --format-version 1
# LANE `features` — every feature-gated module in the workspace, in one pass.
# One lane, not one per crate: cargo unifies features across the workspace, so
# enabling trusty-common's set re-documents nearly every member anyway and a
# second pass would pay that cost again for no additional coverage. candle and
# bundled-ort coexist (only load-dynamic and cuda conflict with bundled-ort at
# the ort-sys level), so the single lane carries both backends.
LANE
LANE
LANE
LANE
LANE
LANE
LANE
LANE
LANE
LANE
LANE
LANE
LANE
LANE
LANE
# NO-CFG — gates no `cfg` site in the crate's own src/**, verified per run.
# A feature that only turns on ANOTHER feature needs no lane of its own: the
# feature it enables is itself a declared feature and carries its own row, so
# the coverage check reaches it either way.
NO-CFG
NO-CFG
NO-CFG
